property.name: Aarunodya Residency Bhakt Niwas
property.tagline: Deluxe A/C & Non A/C Rooms • Near Vitthal-Rukmini Mandir
property.description: Conveniently situated at Nath Chowk, Pandharpur, Aarunodya Residency Bhakt Niwas offers clean, modern, and spiritual hospitality for pilgrims and families visiting the holy shrine of Lord Vitthal & Rukmini Mata. Featuring Deluxe A/C rooms, Non-A/C rooms, and a spacious 3rd-floor group hall.
property.cancellationPolicy: Complimentary cancellation up to 24 hours prior to check-in time.
amenities: Walking Distance to Shri Vitthal-Rukmini Mandir
Pure RO Drinking Water on All Floors

roomTypes.name: Deluxe A/C Room
roomTypes.shortDescription: Modern air-conditioned room with king/queen bed, private western bathroom, and 24/7 hot water.
roomTypes.fullDescription: Perfect for pilgrims and couples seeking a restful, cool stay after Darshan. Features high-efficiency split AC, premium spring mattress, LED TV with devotional channels, private attached bathroom with instant geyser, and daily housekeeping.
roomTypes.bedConfig: 1 King Bed + Extra Mattress on request

images.alt: Deluxe AC Room at Aarunodya Residency
Deluxe AC Room Bedding

roomTypes.name: Comfort Non-A/C Room
roomTypes.shortDescription: Well-ventilated comfortable room with ceiling fan, clean attached bathroom, and 24/7 hot water.
roomTypes.fullDescription: Affordable, clean, and peaceful accommodation designed for devotees. Equipped with a high-speed ceiling fan, comfortable double bed, clean cotton linens, attached bathroom with hot water, and quiet ventilation.

images.alt: Comfort Non-AC Room Bedroom
Comfort Room Interior

roomTypes.name: Family 4-Bed A/C Suite
roomTypes.shortDescription: Spacious family suite with 2 double beds, powerful split AC, and large attached bathroom.
roomTypes.fullDescription: Designed specially for families traveling together for Pandharpur Wari and Darshan. Offers two large double beds, spacious wardrobe, split AC, seating area, and a large attached bathroom with 24/7 hot water.

images.alt: Family Suite with Two Large Beds

roomTypes.name: 3rd Floor Bhakt Niwas Hall (Room 402)
roomTypes.shortDescription: Spacious 3rd-floor private hall (Room 402) for bhajan mandals, dindi groups, and large pilgrim families.
roomTypes.fullDescription: A dedicated, massive 3rd-floor hall (Room 402) accommodating up to 15-20 devotees with comfortable floor bedding/mattresses, multiple clean washrooms, ceiling fans, storage lockers, and open terrace access with temple town panoramic views.

images.alt: Spacious Group Hall at Aarunodya Residency
